desc:
Parkour around the vast city of Kazna, Level Up and compete with others on Time Trials. Boundless gears to be found to bring your gameplay to the next level!

Please buy our gamepasses and like the game!!!! :pleading:

Check settings for key/controller binds, yes you can move the mobile buttons!

Private servers have a command menu in the top right for the owner!

1.5x XP on Friday, Saturday and Sunday!
